ceiling_policy: A ceiling is a statement about one artifact built by one cross toolchain, and the toolchain it was taken with is named in each row's budget.measured.comment. `text_bytes` is the summed .text of every emitted translation unit; `state_bytes` is sizeof(<Model>State) for the target ABI; both are bytes. Ceilings are fall-only in spirit: when size work lands, lower the ceiling in the same change that lands the saving, so the saving cannot be quietly spent again. Raising a ceiling is not forbidden but is never routine, and needs a reviewed justification recorded in the row's comment saying what grew and why the growth is worth the flash. The initial ceilings sit about four percent above the measurement recorded beside them: real headroom for ordinary churn, still tight enough that a five percent regression is red.
fp_ops_policy: `fp_ops` is the number of single-precision floating-point arithmetic instructions in a row's compiled objects, read from `arm-none-eabi-objdump -d` and summed over every emitted translation unit. It counts work, not traffic: the products and fused products, the sums, and the divide and square root. Moves, loads, stores, compares, conversions, sign flips, selections and roundings are excluded. The exact counted set has one owner, the gate's `fp_ops` module, and a single-precision mnemonic in neither its counted nor its excluded list fails the row rather than being counted as free. Bytes say whether the artifact fits; this number is what says whether the step makes its rate on a 600 MHz Cortex-M7 against a 1 ms period, so it is fall-only in the same sense as the size ceilings and for a sharper reason: when contraction work lands, these ceilings come down severalfold in the same change, and a later lowering that reintroduces quartic arithmetic is then red here instead of on the vehicle. The initial ceilings sit about four percent above the measurement recorded beside them.

entries.why: The artifact that flies: the RDD2 navigation estimator as GALEC-derived embedded C, linked into the Zephyr image on the vehicle's microcontroller. Its flash footprint and its single static allocation are acceptance criteria for that deployment, not diagnostics.

measured.comment: Re-measured 2026-08-25 after the per-value working-memory arena landed, with gcc-arm-embedded-15.2.rel1 under arm-none-eabi-gcc -Os -std=c99 -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -ffunction-sections -c over both emitted translation units. state 24344 B (was 31980), of which working memory is 20572 B (was 28208): each region's Real array slots now live at fixed offsets in one flat float arena per region, and two slots share an offset only where the checked projection proved every use of one sequenced apart from every use of the other inside a single activation. The saving is per VALUE rather than per function: the never-concurrent region overlay and the arm overlay are unchanged and still bound which regions may union, the arena packs inside each of them. text 57268 B = 55834 B model + 1434 B shared kernels (was 58648 = 57214 + 1434): the model unit shed 1380 B because a body now addresses its arrays through one const pointer computed at entry instead of repeating the region member path at every use. fp_ops 1098 (was 1094): four more single-precision arithmetic instructions in the objects, from register allocation around the entry pointers, not from any arithmetic the block performs. Behavior witness: every block output of 262 consecutive steps over 13 aiding combinations is byte-identical before and after, dumped as raw words (md5 f11402ae800a86ee924e7b7b4b673d71), and the dossier-rig driver report (scenario 6, 40 warm + 1 correcting step) is byte-identical; executed instructions for that step moved 528679 -> 530475 (+0.34 percent, model-A upper bound over both TUs) with the mul/add/div/sqrt/cmp categories identical. Ceilings LOWERED in the same change that lands the saving, per the fall-only policy: text 61000 -> 59550, state 32680 -> 25300 (about four percent above the new measurements). The fp ceiling is left at 1138 rather than recomputed: the measurement rose slightly, and a fall-only ceiling is never raised to accommodate that. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-25 after the n = 2 fixed-count kernel specializations (`fill_real_2`, `scaled_add_real_2`) were added to the shared library: text 57268 -> 57276 B (the shared kernel TU 1434 -> 1478 B for the two new straight-line bodies, the model unit 55834 -> 55798 B because eighteen call sites shed their `INT32_C(2)` count argument), state 24344 B unchanged, fp_ops 1098 -> 1100 (the two fused multiply-adds inside `scaled_add_real_2` itself, statically counted; the block performs no new arithmetic). Ceilings UNCHANGED and not raised: every row still sits below them. Behavior witness: the whole `NavigationEstimatorState` dumped as raw bytes after each of 262 consecutive steps over 13 aiding combinations is bitwise identical before and after (md5 a129d67520e66b50c8639f926aa9876a), and the dossier-rig driver report (scenario 6, 40 warm + 1 correcting step) is byte-identical; executed instructions for that step moved 530475 -> 529231 (-0.23 percent).

entries.why: The same estimator inside its eFMU Production Code container, the form the certification review reads. Its C bodies come from the same shared templates as the embedded-c-galec row, so the two rows are pinned to the same numbers on purpose: a divergence between them means the packaging track changed what gets compiled rather than only how it is wrapped, which is a finding either way.

entries.why: The heaviest matrix-algebra model with an established eFMI target, and nearly as large as the navigation estimator despite being a smaller model: sigma-point work is where an unrolled kernel or a widened scratch region shows up first, so this row is the early warning for both ceilings.

measured.comment: Re-measured 2026-08-25 after the per-value working-memory arena landed, same toolchain and flags as the NavigationEstimator rows, over ProductionCode/. state 26712 B (was 31292), of which working memory is 23124 B (was 27704): the sigma-point temporaries are the shape the arena is for, a long straight-line chain of same-sized matrices whose live ranges do not overlap. text 54004 B (was 55334); fp_ops 1301 unchanged, which is the check that no arithmetic moved. The saving is smaller in proportion than the NavigationEstimator's because more of this block's storage sits on one deep call chain, where a caller's live intermediates may never be lent to its callee. Ceilings LOWERED with the saving, per the fall-only policy: text 57550 -> 56150, state 32485 -> 27780. fp ceiling unchanged at 1353 against an unchanged measurement. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-25 after the n = 2 fixed-count kernel specializations were added: text 54004 -> 54020 B, state 26712 B unchanged, fp_ops 1301 -> 1303 (the new kernel bodies own arithmetic, statically counted). Ceilings UNCHANGED.

entries.why: The other artifact that flies, and the one on the fast loop: the RDD2 attitude and rate controller as GALEC-derived embedded C, running beside the navigation estimator on the same microcontroller and against a shorter period. It is gated from the day its cross-compile is warning-free on both targets, because a controller that fits only when the estimator happens to be small is not a deployment anyone can plan; its own ceilings say so independently. It is also the corpus's densest user of the Lie-group function library, so a region overlay or a call-boundary decision that regresses on nested small functions shows up here before it shows up on the estimators.
